Collection-level guide to a selected digital catalogue
Scope & content ↓Arrangement ↓Access & use ↓Item inventory ↓

Scope & content

This selected catalogue describes books, critical essays, working papers, diagnostic materials and research publications associated with Museum of One and Dorian Vale. Each item retains its source-specific description, dates, identifiers, rights and version context.

The catalogue was assembled from public Zenodo records and corroborated against institutional work pages. It is not a complete institutional archive or a recovered export of the previous catalogue collection. Original deposit metadata remains available as a source snapshot.

System of arrangement

The three browsing groupings below are a local editorial arrangement. They do not assert an original fonds, a series created by the repository, or a physical storage order. Reference codes MOO-CAT-001 onward identify local item descriptions and remain stable as the catalogue grows.

Research programmes provide contextual relationships where institutional work pages document them. They are distinct from the browsing arrangement and retain their own development stages.

Conditions of access & use

Byte-identical access copies support the in-site document reader. Zenodo remains the source of record. A matching source checksum confirms file identity; it does not establish legal deposit, preservation certification, or an independent backup commitment.

Consult the licence attached to the specific item or edition before reuse. Material reproduced inside a publication can carry separate third-party rights. No physical transfer, acquisition agreement, or original archival custody history is documented by this catalogue.

Item records provide preferred citations and metadata exports. For corrections, contact research@museumofone.art with the reference code and DOI.
